mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 205.0, it signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 205.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% and industrial production falls below 110.0, it signals an overheating labor market combined with weakening industrial activity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
